name: Resume a promo
description: Search past promo projects, peek at where each one stopped, and pick one up in this thread.

slash.name: promo-resume
slash.description: Find a past promo project, peek at where it stopped, and carry on with it here
slash.args: a name or words to search for

activate.message: [mod:promo-projects] {by} wants to pick up a past promo project. Their search words, verbatim: {args}. Run: promo flow projects --out /tmp/promo-projects.json (add --query with their words when there are any), then commissionctl mod publish promo-projects --file /tmp/promo-projects.json. Let them choose; do not resume anything yourself.

resume.message: [mod:promo-projects] {by} picked "{title}" (stopped at {stage_label}) to carry on in this thread. Run: promo flow resume {id}, then publish its promo-flow state with the --project dir it prints, then promo flow projects --resumed {id} --out /tmp/promo-projects.json and publish promo-projects. Carry on from where it stopped, with --project on every promo flow command.

find.message: [mod:promo-projects] {by} cannot see their project in the list. What they said about it: {text}. Look for a folder with flow/flow.json that matches (their projects dir, recent work folders), then promo flow resume PATH and publish promo-projects again with promo flow projects; if nothing matches, say where you looked.
